dedupe_keys.name: fdic bankfind suite bulk data and api institutions branches failures summary of deposits

description: BankFind Suite is the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's public data service on U.S. banks, with an application programming interface and bulk data. The API covers financial institutions, their locations and branches, history of structure change events, aggregate financial and structure data subtotalled by year, failed institutions, the Summary of Deposits (branch-level deposits), financial information per institution and demographics, each documented by a YAML definition file. Queries support filters such as date ranges, and output is JSON or CSV chosen by the request header. Access is free, and users are not currently required to register for an API key. Coverage is the United States, per institution and per branch office, and more data are being added. No licence is stated on the API page read. Caveats: the data describe FDIC-insured institutions only, and financial fields follow regulatory reporting definitions. For simulation it provides the locations of bank branches and their deposits, and bank failures, for exposure of financial service points to hazards, access to cash and financial contagion studies. Related catalogue records include GLEIF LEI data and the Federal Reserve Payments Study.
